s: Dine matztzot hammitzva ubo y"b seipim: kebar nitbaer besiman tn"g sheen adam yotze yede chobato ella bematztza sheyyisrael ben daat nitasseq belishatah vaarikatah vaapiyyatah leshem happesach, abal im beechad mehaasaqim hallalu nitasseq nokri o cheresh shoteh veqatan, [cheresh] dehaynu sheeno shomea veeno medabber, o shoteh dehaynu shemmeabbed mah shennotenim lo, o qatan dehaynu shello hebi shette searot, apillu im yisrael gadol ben daat omed alehem umelammedam umazhiram sheyyitassequ bah leshem happesach — en adam yotze bah, lepi shehannokri eno shomea beqol yisrael hammazhiro vehu oseh al daat atzmo veeno mitkavven leshem happesach, vecheresh shoteh veqatan en bahem daat lekavven leshem happesach. Veap im hem omerim beperush shemmitkavvenim leshem happesach — en kavvanatam umachashabtam shava kelum, kevan sheen bahem daat. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheim yisrael gadol ben daat omed umashgiach alehem shello titchammetz haissa bidehem, ap al pi shehem enam mitkavvenim leshem happesach, sheen tzarik kelal shettehe kavvanat hallisha leshem pesach, ella sheyyehe hashshimmur mechimmutz millisha vaelak leshem happesach kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g, vekan hare yisrael ben daat omed alehem umashgiach al haissa shebbidehem umeshammerah mechimmutz leshem pesach. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq shei epshar beinyan acher, kegon zaqen o choleh shei epshar lo lalush veleepot beatzmo vehu ben hannokrim veen sham yisrael — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom, nakon haddabar sheyyelammed veyazhi[y]r et hannokri sheyyaasoq bah leshem pesach, vegam hu yesayyea qetzat belishatah, sheaz oseh hannokri al daat hayyisrael hamsayyeo velo al daat atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besiman y"a ayyen sham. Veim epshar lo limtzo yisrael apillu cheresh shoteh veqatan, mutab sheyyaasu hem shehem shomeim beqolo veosin ledato, mishsheyyaaseh al yede nokri sheeno shomea beqolo:

Hanniqqur shemmenaqqerin hammatztzot shel mitzva — yesh lehistappeq im muttar laasoto al yede nokri o al yede cheresh shoteh veqatan. Vetob lehachamir lekattechilla apillu yisrael ben daat omed alehem umazhiram sheyyaasu leshem happesach. Abal shear hammatztzot, ap al pi sheyyisrael qedoshim hem venahagu laasot lahem shimmur mechimmutz leshem happesach, mikkol maqom nohagim lenaqqeram al yede qetannim, kevan sheggam gedolim omedim al gabbehem umashgichin al hammatztzot shebbidehem shello yabou lide chimmutz, vezeh niqra shimmur gamur lepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer, ayyen siman ta"z:

Gedole hachakamim hayu mishtaddelin beatzman bematztzot mitzva veomedin al asiyyatan umezorzin et haoseqin bahen umesayyein baarikatan. Veken rauy lekol adam laasot lehittappel hu atzmo bammitzva, shekken hu bekol hammitzvot: "mitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho":

Veakshav shennitqalqelu haddorot verob hamon am en nizharin bekol diqduqim sheddiqdequ chakamim bishmirat hammatztzot mechimmutz — rauy lekol adam ap bishar hammatztzot laamod al asiyyatan, velo lehaamin leamme haaretz:

Hallash issa achar zeman issur chametz — tob sheyyomar bishat lisha: "kol perurin sheyyippelu bishat lisha vaarika veken habbatzeq sheyyidbaq bakkelim ani mebattel umapqir otam". Ukeshehu omer ken, ap kesheyyitchammetzu happerurin — eno ober alehem be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", ap im yesh bahem kezayit kesheyyitqabbetzu veyitdabbequ yachad, kevan shekkebar bittelam qodem shennitchammetzu, sheaz hem adayin birshuto lebattelan ulehapqiran, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"d. Abal im lo yebattelem qodem sheyyitchammetzu — yesh lachosh shemma lo yebaarem min haolam miyyad leachar shennitchammetzu, veyaabor alehem be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" middibre soperim ap sheen bahem kezayit, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b. (Veap shennitbaer besiman tl"d shehapperurim en tzarik lebattelam ulehapqiram kelal shemmealehem hem hepqer, haynu perure happat shei epshar sheyyitdabbequ yachad vekol perur bipne atzmo eno chashub kelum ubatel meelayv, abal perure batzeq kevan sheepshar sheal yede kibbud habbayit yitqabbetzu veyitdabbequ veyihyu chatika achat — yesh bahen chashibut qetzat veenan betelim mealehem). Ukeshemmebattel happerurin yomar: "happerurin yihyu hepqer", o "ani mapqiram", velo kemo shennohagim hamon am lomar: "perurin hepqer", demashma shemmealehem hem hepqer velo shehu mapqiram. Veap sheyyesh mi sheyyishshebu hamminhag, mikkol maqom yoter tob lomar ballashon hamborar yoter, veal kol panim sheyyomar belashon shemmebin, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d:

Uleachar gemar hallisha — tzarik lekabbed et habbayit veet hashshulchan sheasu alayv matztzot veet meqom hallisha, kede lebaer et happerurin, sheap al pi shebbittelam qodem shennitchammetzu, mikkol maqom leachar shennitchammetzu tzarik hu lebaaram shello yihyeh chametz birshuto bepesach, vehapperurin shemmotze — yisrepem, velo yidresem beraglayv beapar, sheap al pi shehem mitbaarim bekak, mikkol maqom kevan shekkebar higgia zeman issur chametz — en biur chametz ella bisrepa lepi minhag medinot ellu. Lepikak, tob shemmiyyad shehapperurin nopelin laaretz qodem sheyyitchammetzu — yidresem beraglayv beapar kede sheyyitbaaru miyyad, velo yitztarek lesorpam achar kak:

En osin seriqin hamtzuyyarin, dehaynu letzayyer bammatztzot kemin chayya vaop, lepi shehu shohe alehen letzayyeran, upeamim yabou lide chimmutz al yede shehiyya zo. Vaapillu hammatztzot hen reqiqim daqqim sheenan memaharin lehachmitz, ap al pi ken aseru chakamim. Vaapillu rotzeh laasot hatztziyyur al yede depus sheeno shoheh kelum, ap al pi ken lo chillequ chakamim bigzeratam, lepi sheharoeh sheyyopeh matztzot metzuyyarot eno yodea shennaasu al yede depus veyabo lehattir laasot belo depus:

Abal hanniqqur shemmenaqqerin hammatztzot kede shello yitpechu, ap al pi sheoseh al yede masreq venaaseh keen tziyyur al hammatztza, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno mitkavven letziyyur — hare zeh muttar. Umikkol maqom, tob lemaher laasoto bekol mah deepshar, shehare keshemmenaqqer miqtzatah haechad shoheh miqtzatah hashsheni belo eseq kelal:
Im abar veasa tziyyurin al hammatztzot — muttarot baakila im lo shaha betziyyuran shiur chimmutz. Vaapillu lekattechilla adam yotze bahen yede chobato:

En osin matztza aba tepach, shekkeshehi aba kol kak yesh lachosh shemma lo yishlot chom haesh betokah vetitchammetz betokah bishat apiyyatah. Abal pachot mittepach apillu mashshehu — muttar laasot lekattechilla meiqqar haddin, lepi shechom hattannur sholet betok obyo kesheen bo tepach. Umikkol maqom, tob laasot hammatztzot reqiqin daqqin, sheen memaharin lehachmitz kol kak kemo haabot kesheadayin hen chutz lattannur. Veim abar veasa matztzot abot tepach o yoter — muttarot baakila. Umikkol maqom, yesh leayyen betok obyah im neepet yapeh velo nitchammetza sham. Veap al pi ken tob shello liqqach otah lematztzot mitzva:

En lehaqel bemah shehechmiru haqqadmonim shello laasot bepesach mine muleyatot, sheqqorin pand"sh o pladyn"sh, dehaynu issot matztzot memullaot bebasar o bigbina, lepi shebbishat apiyya yotze lecha mehabbasar vehaggebina umelachlachat et haissa umeakkebet apiyyatah. Veod shellecha zo dinah keme perot shekkeshehem mitorbim beissa shennillosha bemayim hi memaheret lehachmitz miyyad kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b, veim ken yesh lachosh shemma kesheyyotza hallecha letok haissa nitchammetza miyyad qodem shehispiq chom haesh lishlot bah leepotah. Veken en litten betzim letok hammatztza sheyyitappeh immahem, lepi shehallecha hayyotzea mehem meakkebet apiyyatah. Vaapillu betza mebushshelet en litten ap al pi sheen lecha yotzet mimmenna, mikkol maqom bimqom habbetza en chom haesh sholet sham veen neepeh sham yapeh. Vaapillu bediabad sheshshakach venatan otah betok hammatztza — yesh leesor hammatztza baakila ubahanaa, lepi minhagenu sheanu oserin matztza shennitkappela battannur, lepi sheen chom haesh sholet bimqom hakkepel, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"a ayyen sham:

Abal im natan letokah zereonim apillu enam ketushim — mutteret baakila, lepi sheddabar qatan kazeh eno meakkeb apiyyatah. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lizzaher shello litten letokah apillu debarim qetannim, ella im ken hem ketushim, lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer sheapillu debarim qetannim meakkebim et haapiyya.
